candidates.name: OSTN Update tool
verified_facts: OS describes updating legacy OSTN02/OSGM02 coordinates by transforming back to ETRS89 and then forward using OSTN15/OSGM15.
The update workflow does not include the small OS Net v2001-to-v2009 reference-frame shift.
The page distinguishes transformation-model updating from merely changing coordinate notation.
semantic_limits: A legacy coordinate cannot be assumed current merely because it is expressed as a National Grid coordinate; model version and reference-frame lineage remain required.

candidates.name: Coordinate transformation formats
verified_facts: OS transformation tools accept ETRS89 latitude/longitude with ellipsoidal height and National Grid eastings/northings with optional ODN height.
Input and output format choices describe coordinate representation and height field conventions.
A coordinate-format conversion is distinct from a datum/reference-system transformation.
semantic_limits: Changing decimal, grid or height-field format does not improve spatial accuracy and cannot substitute for OSTN15/OSGM15 transformation or source-specific height provenance.
